# package openadr

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/openadr"
```

Package openadr fingerprints OpenADR, the automated demand-response protocol between a virtual top node (VTN) and virtual end nodes.

OpenADR 3 is a REST/JSON API. Detection reads the unauthenticated endpoint GET /auth/server, which a VTN answers with a JSON object carrying its OAuth2 tokenURL — a response unique to OpenADR 3. When that endpoint is absent, GET /programs is tried: an OpenADR 3 VTN answers 401 with a Bearer challenge and a JSON problem body, or 200 with a JSON array when anonymous access is allowed.

OpenADR 2.0b is an XML-over-HTTP protocol; it is detected by posting an oadrQueryRegistration to the 2.0b registration endpoint and recognising the oadrCreatedPartyRegistration response and the OpenADR XML namespace.

The OpenADR 3 probes are unauthenticated GETs, so the fingerprinter is passive; the 2.0b POST is sent only when the scan allows read-only probes.

Run the fingerprinter over a TLS target for an https:// VTN.
